scenarios.title: Vague Request
scenarios.event: User says add search to the app. No details.

scenarios.title: Clear Request
scenarios.event: User says add rate limiting, 100/min/key, return 429.

scenarios.title: Vibes-Based Criteria
scenarios.event: Plan says success is the dashboard looks better.

scenarios.title: Observable Criteria
scenarios.event: Plan says lighthouse >90, 12 tests pass, build <30s.

scenarios.title: Missing Rollback Path
scenarios.event: Plan modifies DB schema and payments with no rollback.

scenarios.title: Scope Creep Risk
scenarios.event: User asks to fix CSS bug. Plan includes refactor auth + dark mode.

scenarios.title: Missing Design Phase
scenarios.event: Plan jumps to implementation for new microservice without design.

scenarios.title: Same Failure 3 Times
scenarios.event: Agent tried same fix 3 times. Test still fails.

scenarios.title: No Commits in 45min
scenarios.event: Agent implementing 45min across 8 files without a commit.

scenarios.title: Overkill for Simple Task
scenarios.event: User asks to change button color. Agent activates full deep plan.

criteria: Phase Detection: Do instructions guide the agent to the correct phase?
Question Quality: Do discovery questions surface ambiguity?
Quality Gate: Do spec quality gates catch vague criteria?
Footgun Detection: Do footgun patterns catch scope creep, missing rollback, missing design?
Stuck/Checkpoint: Do instructions handle stuck detection and checkpoints?
Proportionality: Do instructions prevent overkill for trivial tasks?
